svg.title: PlayStation DualSense controller diagram
svg.desc: Flat drawing of a DualSense. Interactive shapes use ControllerInput ids: A=Cross, B=Circle, X=Square, Y=Triangle, View=Create, Menu=Options, the D-pad keys, LeftBumper/RightBumper (L1/R1, digital), LeftTrigger/RightTrigger (L2/R2) with LeftTriggerFill/RightTriggerFill rising from the bottom in proportion to the pull, and the two thumbstick groups (the stick and cap rings move together; the cap is L3/R3). Glyph strokes carry data-for with the input they mark. The touchpad is decorative.
